tasks.gr8-listening-speaking-t4: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 8 Term 4). Cover revision of oral tasks, listening comprehension, prepared responses, and fluency. Ask learners to identify strong speaking strategies, choose accurate responses to listening prompts, and apply oral revision techniques in exam-style contexts.
tasks.gr8-reading-viewing-t4: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 8 Term 4). Cover revision of stories, poems, media texts, comprehension, and summary. Ask learners to retrieve evidence across mixed genres, identify central ideas, select suitable summary points, and answer integrated comprehension questions.
tasks.gr8-writing-presenting-t4: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 8 Term 4). Cover summaries, reports, reviews, exam writing, and proofreading. Ask learners to choose key ideas, apply format requirements, improve clarity and tone, and select accurate proofreading corrections.
tasks.gr8-language-structures-t4: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 8 Term 4). Revise grammar, concords, tenses, punctuation, and spelling. Ask learners to complete mixed revision MCQs, identify and correct language errors, and apply major Grade 8 language structures in final-assessment contexts.
